product_family: Comprehensive cybersecurity platform with network security (Harmony SASE, firewalls, WAF), cloud security (CloudGuard), workspace security (email, endpoint, mobile), and AI-powered solutions (Workforce AI Security, ThreatCloud AI). Founded 1993, publicly traded, global enterprise-tier vendor.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point holds SOC 2 Type II certification, which addresses 'the suitability of the design and operating effectiveness of the controls described therein to meet the applicable trust services criteria'. The Type II report covers Workspace Security, Infinity Platform, and Quantum & CloudGuard products across multiple trust service principles.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point demonstrates ISO 27001 & 27002 compliance, confirming they meet standards for information security management systems and risk management. Certificate available for download.

certifications.name: ISO 27002
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27002 provides best practice recommendations to support ISO 27001 compliance. Check Point's certifications confirm alignment with both standards.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point demonstrates GDPR compliance posture including DPA availability for customers and distributors, GDPR Statement, EU Standard Contractual Clauses, data residency options (EU, US, India, Australia), and explicit privacy rights procedures. Privacy policy states compliance with EEA/UK data subject rights.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point SASE is stated to 'help achieve HIPAA compliance goals' and is mentioned as supporting HIPAA requirements, but no formal HIPAA certification or Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is explicitly documented or confirmed. Evidence indicates capability/alignment rather than formal certification.

certifications.name: FIPS 140-2
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point Force R81.20 and R82, SMB Spark R81.10.10, Security Gateway cryptographic module (Certificate #4264), and Endpoint Security FDE/MEPP (Certificate #2788) hold FIPS 140-2 certification.

certifications.name: Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408)
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point Security Gateway and Management products are certified to EAL4+ and current Protection Profiles under Common Criteria.

certifications.name: C5 (German BSI Cloud Computing Compliance)
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point holds C5 certification from German BSI (Federal Office for Information Security) for cloud computing compliance controls.

certifications.name: CESG NCSC Cyber Essentials Plus
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point products meet CESG NCSC Cyber Essentials Plus UK cybersecurity certification standards.

certifications.name: NSA CSfC (Commercial Solutions for Classified)
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point products are recognized under the NSA Commercial Solutions for Classified program.

certifications.name: HITRUST
certifications.proof_quote: HITRUST is mentioned in educational content (glossary entry) but no evidence that Check Point holds an active HITRUST certification. No entry found on HITRUST registry.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point is pursuing FedRAMP authorization, with public statements targeting approval 'sometime in 2025' for SaaS products including Harmony Email & Collaboration, Harmony Endpoint, and CloudGuard. Certification is not yet active.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point's Secure AI Advisory Service is aligned to ISO 42001 standards and helps customers achieve compliance, but Check Point itself does not hold an ISO 42001 certification. They provide governance service using ISO 42001 as a framework.

certifications.name: CIS Controls Alignment
certifications.proof_quote: Check Point platform 'aligns with more than 40 CIS Safeguards across 11 of the 18 CIS Controls' from Center for Internet Security.

privacy.ai_training_note: Check Point states: 'We may use telemetry, threat indicators, interaction data, and other data processed through the Services to enhance the efficiency, security, functionality, and performance of our Services, including capabilities powered by artificial intelligence.' When acting as a processor, 'any AI-related processing of customer data is carried out in connection with providing, maintaining, securing, and enhancing our Services' and 'Check Point does not use customer data for unrelated purposes.' Customers can download DPA and have it signed. DPA version control and sub-processor list maintained.
privacy.data_region: EU (Ireland), US, India, Australia - customers can select preferred data residency region during onboarding

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Confirmed - SASE platform includes encryption of transmitted data with TLS/SSL support

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Confirmed - FIPS 140-2 certified cryptographic modules for data at rest protection

security.name: Data access controls
security.value: Confirmed - Role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication, zero-trust security model across products

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure program
security.value: Available - Vulnerability Disclosure Policy documented on Trust Center

security.name: Data breach notification
security.value: Confirmed - Personal Data Breach Policy on Trust Center outlines response procedures

security.name: Sub-processor transparency
security.value: Confirmed - Sub-processor list available on Trust Center, vendors assessed via Vendors Information Security Assessment Policy

security.name: AI governance
security.value: Formal AI Policy on Trust Center outlining responsible use of generative AI with data handling, privacy, transparency, and accountability directives

security.name: Claude Compliance API integration
security.value: Check Point Workforce AI Security integrates with Claude Enterprise via Compliance API for audit-grade visibility, DLP scanning of Claude interactions, and per-user activity tracking across web, desktop, and mobile

products.name: Harmony SASE
products.data_scope: Network traffic, user activity, threat data
products.notes: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA-ready. Supports multiple data residency regions. Includes firewall, VPN, WAF, DDoS, secure web gateway, and zero trust capabilities.

products.name: Workforce AI Security
products.data_scope: User interactions with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.), DLP scanning, activity logs
products.notes: New AI security product. Integrates with Claude Enterprise via Compliance API for visibility and DLP. Scans for PII, credentials, regulated data.

products.name: CloudGuard
products.data_scope: Cloud infrastructure, workload security, container scanning, code security
products.notes: Multi-cloud platform for AWS, Azure, GCP. Includes CNAPP, code security, cloud posture management. Pursuing FedRAMP certification.

products.name: Endpoint Protection Platform
products.data_scope: Endpoint threat detection, behavior analysis, malware protection
products.notes: FIPS 140-2 certified FDE and MEPP components. Includes mobile threat defense.

products.name: Email & Collaboration Security
products.data_scope: Email content, attachment scanning, collaboration tool activity
products.notes: Gartner Magic Quadrant leader. SOC 2 Type 2 certified. Pursuing FedRAMP certification.

products.name: ThreatCloud AI
products.data_scope: Global threat intelligence, malware samples, vulnerability data
products.notes: AI-powered threat intelligence platform. Product Privacy Data Sheet available on Trust Center.

products.name: WAF (Web Application Firewall)
products.data_scope: Web traffic, API requests, application layer threats
products.notes: Cloud and on-premises deployment. SOC 2 Type 2 certified.

products.name: Quantum & Next-Generation Firewalls
products.data_scope: Network traffic, threat prevention, IPS/IDS data
products.notes: On-premises network security. Common Criteria EAL4+, FIPS 140-2 certified. Gartner Magic Quadrant leader.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise subscription-based with tiered service levels. Harmony SASE includes per-user licensing. Professional services and managed security services available.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region: EU (Ireland), US, India, Australia. Customers choose during onboarding. Governed by Standard Contractual Clauses and UK International Data Transfer Addendum.

flags: HIPAA: Marketing states Harmony SASE 'helps achieve HIPAA compliance' but no formal HIPAA certification or signed BAA documented. Appears to be capability-based rather than formally certified.
FedRAMP: Mentioned in homepage and materials as future target (2025), but certification is not yet active. Risk of user confusion with aspirational vs. current status.
ISO 42001: Check Point aligns their Secure AI Advisory Service to ISO 42001 standards to help customers comply, but Check Point itself does not hold the certification. Clear distinction maintained.
HITRUST: Mentioned in educational/glossary content but no evidence of Check Point holding active HITRUST certification.

PCI DSS: Referenced in community discussions and downloadable sample reports, but company-wide certification status unclear—may be product-specific or customer-applicable rather than vendor certification.
CSA STAR: Not confirmed. CSA CCoP 2.0 mentioned in community but not CSA STAR certification.
Responsible AI document (PDF) is available but detailed content could not be fully extracted for verification due to PDF format.
